description:
A self-developed Fused deposition modeling slicing software produced by Creality.

Creality Print is a self-developed Fused deposition modeling slicing software produced by Creality. It’s a practical and easy-to-use tool that can help you remote control and monitor your 3D printer and help print directly from your computer.
1. Added a pre-flush volume setting after filament change, printing thick lines on the wipe tower to address filament degradation on the i8; set it to 0 to disable pre-flushing.
2. Added speed control for unsupported solid infill and sloped-surface infill, detecting unsupported paths and lowering their print speed to reduce failure risk.
3. Added a minimum print thickness for color-mixing sublayers to reduce overly thin sublayers and improve stability in color-mixing and gradient printing.
4. Fixed an issue where updated online parameters did not take effect.
5. Added a temperature setting for the low-temperature heat-enhancing build plate.
